memoryDocument.patientOverview:
73-year-old male with ischemic cardiomyopathy/HFrEF (EF 30-35%; fixed inferior/inferolateral scar, moderate functional MR, severely dilated LA 4.8 cm), 3-vessel CAD medically managed (2018 cath LAD 60%, LCx 50%, RCA 70%), CKD 3b (diabetic nephropathy plus hypertensive nephrosclerosis; Cr ~1.9-2.0, eGFR ~32-40; UACR 145 (1/2022), 150 (7/2021 and 7/2023), 165 (9/2024), 180 (12/2023-3/2024), 380 (8/2025, nephrology; prior 350-400); small kidneys; PTH 78-89 (88 on 8/2025), vit D 21-22, acidosis improved on bicarbonate (HCO3 19 to 21 by 8/2025), anemia Hgb ~10.8-11 treated with IV iron sucrose 1 g in 1/2022; renal artery stenosis excluded 10/2023), T2DM since ~2010 with severe sensorimotor neuropathy (foot drop, monofilament 0/10 by 9/2023, IWGDF 3), mild NPDR, PAD signs, persistent AFib, HTN, hyperlipidemia, obesity, OSA on CPAP (auto 8-12, AHI 3.4, 5.2 h/night per 2/2022), BPH with nocturia, GERD, lumbar DDD, knee OA, gout 2019 (allopurinol stopped 1/2020), hepatic steatosis (FIB-4 2.3), 20 pack-year former smoker (quit 1995; RT note says 30 pack-years), mild restrictive PFTs, negative V/Q 2019 and 5/2023, tubular adenoma 2018. Allergies: penicillin anaphylaxis (1985; some notes say rash) and sulfa; ACEi angioedema (lisinopril 2018) vs hyperkalemia; NSAID intolerance (GI hemorrhage) added to the list 9/2023.

Earlier history: labs from 2/2018-4/2020 already show CKD3b (Cr 1.45-2.33, eGFR 27-47) and markedly labile sodium (2/2018 147 x2 (2/26, 3/1); 2018: 117 on 7/14, 120 on 8/17, 123 on 8/2, 159 on 10/27, 161 on 11/30; 2019: 124 on 1/3, 157 on 3/4, 123 on 6/13, 115 on 7/28, 158 on 8/26, 146 on 9/23, 134 on 11/27, 155 on 12/20; 2020: 120 on 1/25, 125-126 in 2/2020, 145 on 2/29, 122 on 4/6, 158 on 4/20). Earliest labs 2/2018: BNP 433 (2/26/2018), K 5.41, CO2 17.7, Ca 10.92 and 10.36 (hypercalcemia), Hgb 13.8 with MCV 104.9 and Hct 31.7 discordant, INR 0.92, troponin 0, phos 4.96. A1c 5.81-9.42 in 2018, 6.94-8.99 in 2019-2020, K up to 5.47-5.59 in 4-5/2018, BNP 329 on 10/6/2018, 392/troponin 0.04 on 2/8/2020. HF decompensations 11/2020-3/2021 (BNP 493 11/27/2020, 440 12/28/2020, 510 1/2021, 603-605 3/2021), 7/2021 (wt 100.2, furosemide 40 to 60 BID x3 d), 10/2021 (wt 100.8, 60 BID x5 d), 12/2021, 2/2022 BNP 538, 4/2023 (wt 99.5, extra furosemide), 8/2022 (admission, BNP 1850); 2/10-2/14/2021 S. pneumoniae CAP admission (SpO2 89% RA, ceftriaxone x5 days tolerated despite penicillin anaphylaxis; Morse fall score 55); 9/2021 UTI nitrofurantoin. Warfarin 5 mg (INR 2.2-2.7) used through 8/2023 (INR 2.4 on 8/2023; enoxaparin bridge planned for 9/8/2023 colonoscopy). Carvedilol uptitrated 2021 (10/2021 note: 12.5 AM/25 PM per Dr. Chen 9/2021) toward 25 BID; later notes list 12.5 BID in 11-12/2022 and 9/2023 pharmacy note (conflicting). Entresto 97/103 BID prior-authorization needed 4/2023 (step therapy). ICD discussed 10/2022 and deferred; SGLT2i discussed since 8/2021.

9/2023: ibuprofen 400 TID x3 days plus warfarin (INR 3.8) plus aspirin led to hemorrhagic shock from a gastric ulcer (Forrest IIa; epinephrine, cautery, hemoclip x2 9/13/2023). Accounts conflict: MDT/ICU notes 1.5 cm lesser curve, Hgb 7.2, INR 3.8, 4 u pRBC, H. pylori treated; a mis-dated telephone note (NOTE100, dated 3/2021) describes 2.5 cm antral ulcer, Hgb 5.8, INR 4.2, FFP, H. pylori triple therapy with amoxicillin. Pharmacy note: clarithromycin plus metronidazole 14 d (amoxicillin avoided for penicillin allergy), pantoprazole 40 BID x14 d then daily, atorvastatin held 9/15-9/28 and restarted 9/29, metformin held for AKI (Cr 2.8) until Cr <=2.0, warfarin permanently stopped, aspirin 81 resumed 9/15 as sole antithrombotic. MDT conference 9/15/2023: CHA2DS2-VASc 5, HAS-BLED 5; warfarin resumption declined; apixaban declined unless stroke/TIA; LAAO discussed. H. pylori eradication confirmed 10/11/2023; EGD 4/2024 healed, GI said apixaban may be reconsidered. Notes from 2/2024 and 2025 stating 'continue anticoagulation' conflict with off-OAC status (likely templated). Social work 9/2023: full code, wife Patricia preferred proxy (son David alternate), no formal POA/living will at that time (2/2021 nursing note says proxy and living will on file; conflict). Other events: 9/2024 observation stay, fall 9/2024; 9/6-9/10/2025 ADHF with AKI (Cr peak 2.3-2.4); mechanical fall 9/12/2025; 10/2/2025 mild volume overload (99.0 kg) from sodium indiscretion, extra furosemide 20 mg.

Recent course: finasteride started 11/2024; PSA 3.2 (6/2024); AUA 18. 11/2025 phone note: decreased interest, stopped church choir, early waking, appetite down, feels like a burden, PHQ-2 2/6; 1/2026 PHQ-9 8; attended 2 of 4 social work sessions by 2/5/2026, reluctant on medication. 1/27/2026 weight 97.2 kg, BNP 410. Labs 1/11/2026: Cr 2.03, eGFR 39.5, K 4.46. Most recent (1/28/2026 per 2/5/2026 call): Cr 1.96, eGFR 35.4, K 4.8, Na 135, HCO3 23, BUN 38, Hgb 11.1, A1c 7.4, BNP 410; home glucose fasting 130-170; weights 97-97.5 kg; neuropathy 4/10; nocturia 2-3x; PCP visit scheduled 3/10/2026. Hgb 13.9 on 1/11/2026 is discordant with 11.1 on 1/28/2026. Chart date inconsistencies: empagliflozin start documented as May 2024 (NOTE037, NOTE035) and May 2025 (NOTE017); several 2024-dated notes reference 2025 events. 9/14/2023 labs (Hgb 12.9, INR 0.95) discordant with the bleed course. Atorvastatin 80 mg per 9/2024 note vs 40 mg elsewhere.
